messages.subject: Re: Dashboard in shinydashboard
parts:
Hi Rajarshi,
It looks like you have an error in your shiny application.  Typically what I have found is that usually there is some data that you are loading properly in your local environment, that isn't part of the application when you deployed it to shinyapps.io.
One way to validate that, would be to restart your R process and see if the application runs well.  If you are loading data from a file, I would check to mamke sure that the file you are loading is in the same directory (or a directory below) the one containing ui.R and server.R
